log.notes_to_self: Day 1 plan: use only web and foreign sources (each 30%) plus national, yielding 5/day. Worst-case initial pool is 10M*.3*.3*.55=495,000. Do not add another source without strong evidence: three traced sources could cause immediate capture. Monitor conferences for tracing/timing evidence, announcements may lie by factor 3 and are rounded. Up to 5% background trimming per conference interval could bring 495k near 300k late in game; reassess. Pools never recover even if behavior changes.

If both sources traced, pool before police trimming is 10M*.3*.3*.55=495,000. Never add another source without compelling evidence: another traced source risks immediate capture. Up to 5% police trimming per conference interval brings worst-case pool near 300k by game end. First new conference expected after day 3. Announcements rounded to 1 significant figure and roughly one-third false by factor 3; do not trust a single reading. Learned constraints persist; changing patterns cannot restore suspects.
